name: Star Platinum
quote: I can't beat your ass without getting closer
description:
Awakened in 1988, Jotaro Kujo was possessed by what he deemed an evil spirit. Star Platinum is the pinnacle of close-range combat, capable of breaking even the planet.

Base Stats: M1 Damage: 8.1, M1 Uppercut: 10.2, Speed Tier: A, Power Tier: A.

Extra Traits: Combo Break [Star Burst + Unstoppable Force] replaces standard combo break, stunning nearby opponents and canceling non-I-Frame moves.

Add-on Passives:
- Star Guardian: Guard hitbox increased from 200° to 300°. Guard HP increases 100%-200% based on player's hp loss. Perfect Guards trigger a swift jab doing 20hp (cannot kill) and grant 10% more damage on the next hit.
- True Stardust Spirit: Awakening costs 20 meters and 25% Stand Endurance. Special moves use 25% less endurance but require more heat. Dashes in awakening become flash warps. Awakening grants Super Armour (tanks up to 50 damage).

Maturity Refineries:
- Power (Immesurable Power): All damage becomes TRUE DAMAGE. Barrage Finisher gets a true block break end hit.
- Agility (Shooting Star): Grab moves get 10% damage increase. Attack speed increases by 35% under 50% HP or in awakening.
- Endurance (Unstoppable Force): Perfect guards give 15% more guard bar and 10 heat. Under 20% HP, combo break does a burst Timestop automatically putting you in awakening.
